sentences.text: Di desa Budi, puncak musim kemarau biasanya jatuh pada bulan Juli.

sentences.text: Hujan deras itu hanya turun sekejap, lalu matahari muncul lagi.

sentences.text: Petugas pertanian memusnahkan tanaman yang terserang hama wereng.
sentences.en: Agricultural officers destroyed plants that were attacked by planthoppers.
sentences.ko: 농업 담당자들이 멸구 피해를 입은 작물을 없앴어요.

sentences.text: Dalam cerita film itu, seorang raja jahat ingin memusnahkan seluruh desa.
sentences.en: In the film's story, an evil king wants to wipe out the entire village.
sentences.ko: 그 영화 이야기에서 악한 왕은 마을 전체를 없애려고 해요.

sentences.text: Para petani mendiskusikan jadwal tanam di balai desa.
sentences.en: The farmers discussed the planting schedule at the village hall.
sentences.ko: 농부들은 마을 회관에서 모내기 일정을 의논했어요.

sentences.text: Siti dan sutradara mendiskusikan cara memerankan tokoh ibu yang keras.
sentences.en: Siti and the director discussed how to play the strict mother character.
sentences.ko: 시티와 감독은 엄격한 어머니 역을 어떻게 연기할지 의논했어요.
